snp5.10:1.1: Todeyyamāṇavapucchā (9). "Yasmiṃ kāmā na vasanti, icc-āyasmā Todeyyo taṇhā yassa na vijjati, kathaṃkathā ca yo tiṇṇo, vinokho tassa kīdiso". || ||
snp5.10:2.1: "Yasmiṃ kāmā na vasanti, Todeyyā ti Bhagavā taṇhā yassa na vijjati, kathaṃkathā ca yo tiṇṇo, vimokho tassa naparo". || ||
snp5.10:3.1: "Nirāsayo so uda āsasāno, paññāṇavā so uda paññakappī: muniṃ ahaṃ Sakka yathā vijaññaṃ, tam me viyācikkha samantacakkhu". || ||
snp5.10:4.1: "Nirāsayo so na so āsasāno, paññāṇavā so na ca paññakappī: evam pi Todeyya muniṃ vijāna akiñcanaṃ kāmabhave asattan" ti || || TODEYYAMĀṆAVAPUCCHĀ NIṬṬHITĀ.
